1.title: Videos Shed Light on Pursuit Before ICE Killing in Houston
1.summary: Surveillance footage obtained by The Times shows ICE agents driving aggressively in unmarked vehicles, but the moment of the fatal shooting of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo remains murky.

2.title: Trump administration subpoenas New York Times journalists over Air Force One reporting
2.summary: The reporters received the legal summons after they reported on alleged security issues with the president's new plane, which was gifted by Qatar.

3.title: Trump-Appointed Judge Reluctantly Grants Dismissal of Proud Boys Case
3.summary: Judge Timothy J. Kelly, a federal judge in Washington, noted that he had little choice but to accept the Trump administration’s move to end the case.

4.title: Iran must pledge to stop shooting at ships in Strait of Hormuz, US officials say
4.summary: US media say Iran has told US officials an attack on ships crossing the strait early this week was "a mistake".

5.title: U.S. Citizen Tests Positive for Ebola in Democratic Republic of Congo
5.summary: The American, who works for the humanitarian organization Samaritan’s Purse, is the second to be infected in an outbreak that continues to spread.
